annotations.title: Fix the SEO of a web page

description: Runs the SEO Records correction engine (the one inside the SEO Records module) on a public page and returns every correction it would apply: the value, the source it comes from, and the exact HTML tag to add or replace in <head> — title, meta description, canonical URL, hreflang, Open Graph and Twitter preview, JSON-LD structured data, image alt texts, robots directives. Also returns the Google snippet before and after, and the issues left to the author because they touch visible content (missing h1, vague link texts…). The page is read, corrected in memory, and forgotten. Requires this connector's access pass (€9.90 for 24 hours, or €29 per month). Docs: https://seorecords.com/assistants

access_key.description: Access key (pass_…) of this connector, shown after buying its 24-hour pass or monthly subscription. Required.

url.description: The page address, e.g. example.com/page or https://example.com/

name: fix_page_seo
